notes.title: DROP - System Breach April Update
notes.content:
Here's the summary of the April Update:

Accessibility: 
It can be a bit harder to see the difference between the elements of the Proxy Gateway minigame for some players. We fix it by putting small icons on those elements.

Easy read mode:
Some players found the screen effects overwhelming.
We introduce a new menu element that allows the players to turn the easy-read mode on, turning off some effects.

Updated level sequence:
The player can continue the game after they finish the story with additional procedurally generated levels.

Minor Bug Fixes:
- Fixed a bug that prevented the user to get to the game over screen if he was in a shocked or locked state.
- Fixed a few levels where the game didn't generate enough target accounts to be able to complete certain objectives.
- Fixed minor localization typos.
- Fixed the issue of the settings not being saved correctly.

notes.title: DROP Steam Next Fest Stream
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42439053/6259fdb2c129ade67f86f68e66cf34ff0f61f724.png[/img]

We are broadcasting a playthrough of our demo.
It is 1 hour long and shows all the game's features.

Feel free to comment in the Discussion Forum or on Discord!

Forum: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1902300/discussions/]LINK[/url]

Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/microprose-official-681523353651249174]LINK[/url]

The future is cold, disconnected, and paranoid. The world has recoiled and fractured into countless digital enclaves and virtual fortresses in an era of digital isolation, suspicion, and espionage. In this world, there’s only one truth: hackers get fame, money, and dead if they’re not careful. 

You are a promising hacker with huge ambitions, an empty bank account, and the burning desire to prove yourself. When your actions attract the attention of a notorious hacker group, The Swarm, life gets complicated - real quick. 

Your world turns upside-down when simple jobs hurl you into a power struggle between The Swarm, different factions, and megacorporations that could decide the fate of the world’s fragmented networks. Use your cunning, stealth, and prowess to stay ahead of what lurks around the next node.

[h2][b]Key features[/b][/h2]
Drop is a fast-paced rogue-like hacking simulator with unique visuals and electronic soundscapes that evoke the thrill of hacking.
Hack networks to gain respect and notoriety within the community.
Find solutions to a myriad of complex puzzles.
Work against time, firewalls, and other nerve-racking hazards to get paid.
Procedurally generated side quests offer unlimited playtime.
Play an unfolding story campaign through unique missions. Explore the opportunities offered by the numerous factions with their agendas and assignments.
Intense gameplay is controlled through an elegantly-simple keyboard or gamepad configuration.
